message.echoesofoblivion.milestone.watch: It has begun to notice you.
message.echoesofoblivion.milestone.compl: The fragments are whole. Something waits at the end of the corridor.
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.not_collec: You never truly witnessed this memory.
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.no_target: There is nothing nearby to unsettle.
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.already_us: This memory is spent; it no longer cuts.
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.hit: The memory deals %s conceptual damage (%s stability left)
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.resonant_h: Resonance! The memory deals %s conceptual damage (%s stability left)
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.defeated: The silence breaks. You brought back the truth - and its gaze.
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.need_memor: You have not witnessed every memory; it will not answer.
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.need_infec: This place is not yet corrupted; the rite cannot hold.
message.echoesofoblivion.boss.summoned: The air thickens. The Silent Aggregate descends.
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_0.title: The Fall
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_0.content: I still remember the day the sky cracked.\nWe thought we had achieved perfection.\nWe were wrong.
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_1.title: The First Silence
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_1.content: When the first voice faded, we called it a miracle.\nWhen the last voice faded, we understood.\nSilence is not peace. It is the absence of everything.
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_1.clue: Clue: the absence of every sound
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_2.title: The Architects
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_2.content: We built more than cities.\nWe built bridges between thoughts, ladders between dreams.\nAnd when those bridges collapsed, we fell together.
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_3.title: The Last Experiment
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_3.content: The Apparatus hummed with light never seen before.\nIt was the last thing we ever saw clearly.\nAfter that, only echoes.
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_4.title: The Warning
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_4.content: She tried to warn us.\nHer words twisted mid-air, becoming something else.\nSomething that listened back.
memory.echoesofoblivion.memory_4.clue: Clue: the thing that listens back
memory.echoesofoblivion.resonance.sky_ap: The crack was not a wound. It was a door we opened on purpose.
memory.echoesofoblivion.resonance.silenc: The bridges ran both ways. We paid for every crossing with quiet.
memory.echoesofoblivion.resonance.bridge: We called it progress. We never asked what the medium was made of.
memory.echoesofoblivion.resonance.appara: She warned us about the Apparatus. The Apparatus edited the warning.
memory.echoesofoblivion.resonance.warnin: She never spoke again after that. We assumed she had said enough.
screen.echoesofoblivion.codex.no_resonan: Nothing has resonated yet. Match a clue to a memory.
screen.echoesofoblivion.codex.empty_body: Someone started to write it down. It did not finish.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_scroll.desc: A record of what you have witnessed
fragment.echoesofoblivion.founding.title: On the Founding
fragment.echoesofoblivion.founding.text: Before the bridges we had only our own heads, and each of us believed that was enough.\nIt was the first thing we were wrong about.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.first_bridge.t: He thought of a door.\nI thought of the same door, at the same moment, without being told.\nWe wrote it down because we did not know what else to do with it.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.choir_record.t: Entry 1: two minds, overlap 4 seconds.\nEntry 412: nine minds, overlap 40 seconds. No one could say afterwards which thought was whose.\nEntry 413: overlap has no measured end. We have stopped counting.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.cost_ledger.te: Item: one measure of quiet, per crossing, per mind.\nProjected total at current expansion: unrecoverable.\nRecommendation: continue. The expense is ours, and it is only quiet.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.letter_home.te:
I am writing this instead of sleeping.
The Choir is wider than it was, and everyone is pleased. I am pleased.
I only wanted to put down that last night I woke and could not find the edge of my own thought.
There was no edge. I am sure it is nothing.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.her_first_note: I have listened to the hum for eleven nights.\nIt is not a sound. A sound has a source.\nIt is a place, and we have been widening the road to it.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.apparatus_spec: Function: to establish a chamber of quiet that cannot be entered or replaced.\nCost: the chamber must first be emptied of all sound.\nNote: this is not a flaw. This is the mechanism.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.the_quiet_orde:
By unanimous silence of the Choir:
1. No speech.
2. No writing of speech.
3. No names.
Signed: (no signature)
fragment.echoesofoblivion.after.title: After
fragment.echoesofoblivion.after.text: Seventy days without incident.\nWe have kept the Order. We do not know what we were keeping it from.\nNothing has been written here for some time. This entry is only to mark that we are still here.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.prayer_first.t: To the place where sound used to be:\nwe did not mean to build here.\nPlease give back what we paid, and keep the rest.
fragment.echoesofoblivion.prayer_last.te: We are not being punished.\nThere is no one left to punish us.
item.echoesofoblivion.ruins_compass.desc: Points toward the nearest memory crystal
item.echoesofoblivion.ruins_compass.none: Nothing answers. There is no crystal within reach.
item.echoesofoblivion.purification_agent: Clears the infection in a small area around you
It does not cleanse what you have already learned.
item.echoesofoblivion.resonance_fork.hin: Right-click to perform. Sneak-right-click to change rite.
ritual.echoesofoblivion.requiem.desc: Scatters every echo within 32 blocks. Costs 1 Ossuary Ash.
ritual.echoesofoblivion.descent.desc: Silences the world within 48 blocks for 30 seconds. Costs 1 Silence Shard and 2 Void Embers.
ritual.echoesofoblivion.descent.done: You have done what they did. Listen to nothing.
ritual.echoesofoblivion.void_passage.des: Cross between worlds without a portal. Costs 1 Mirror Shard and 10 corruption.
message.echoesofoblivion.burn.not_witnes: You never witnessed this memory. There is nothing to burn.
message.echoesofoblivion.burn.done: %s burns away. The memory is gone; %s
message.echoesofoblivion.burn.effect.sil: the echoes nearby stop, but do not leave.
message.echoesofoblivion.burn.effect.war: there was no infection here to push back.
message.echoesofoblivion.burn.hint: Sneak and press the memory attack key to burn it.
Right-click a memory crystal to take a sample. The crystal stays readable.
It does not destroy what it touches.
The seal breaks. A fragment surfaces.
item.echoesofoblivion.stabilizer.desc: For %s seconds, the world holds its shape.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_vial.cost: It is paid for with a memory. You do not choose which.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_vial.used: %s is gone. You feel lighter, and less.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_vial.used_e: Nothing left to give. It takes anyway.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_vial.clear: There is nothing in you left to relieve.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_blade.desc: Heavier against echoes than against the living.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_blade.usele: The Silent Aggregate cannot be cut.
item.echoesofoblivion.memory_blade.no_ef: The blade passes through. There is nothing there to cut.
item.echoesofoblivion.shatter_staff.desc: Right-click to break the echoes you can see.
item.echoesofoblivion.shatter_staff.usel: It does nothing to the Aggregate.
item.echoesofoblivion.researcher_lantern: While carried, corruption builds at half speed.
She carried it to the end. It did not save her.
block.echoesofoblivion.fragment_niche.ta: The niche gives up what it was holding.
block.echoesofoblivion.fragment_niche.em: You are already carrying everything it had.
